sections.heading: Lead
Background
sections.wikitext: "I Get Around" was written by [[Brian Wilson]] and [[Mike Love]].{{sfn|Dillon|2012|p=34}} Wilson was originally listed as the sole author of the song. After Love [[Love v. Wilson|sued Wilson for songwriting credits in the 1990s]], he was awarded official co-writing credits on 35 Beach Boys songs, including "I Get Around".{{sfn|Love|2016|pp=359, 578, 586}} Asked about the authorship of "I Get Around" during the court proceedings, Wilson responded, "I [wrote it], with the exception of a possible – possibility that Mike wrote the intro, the 'round 'round.'"{{sfn|Love|2016|p=579}}
sections.text: "I Get Around" was written by Brian Wilson and Mike Love.{{sfn|Dillon|2012|p=34}} Wilson was originally listed as the sole author of the song. After Love sued Wilson for songwriting credits in the 1990s, he was awarded official co-writing credits on 35 Beach Boys songs, including "I Get Around".{{sfn|Love|2016|pp=359, 578, 586}} Asked about the authorship of "I Get Around" during the court proceedings, Wilson responded, "I [wrote it], with the exception of a possible – possibility that Mike wrote the intro, the 'round 'round.'"{{sfn|Love|2016|p=579}}

Per John Brode, Will Crerar, Joshilyn Hoisington, and Craig Slowinski.<ref name="BBSessions2026">{{cite web |title=The All Summer Long Sessions |url=https://beachboyssessions.com/all-summer-long/|website=beachboyssessions.com |publisher=Austin Heller |access-date=August 26, 2026}}</ref><ref name="Slowinski2014">{{cite AV media notes| title = Keep an Eye On Summer 1964 | others= [[The Beach Boys]]| year = 2014| first = Craig| last = Slowinski|publisher=[[Capitol Records]]|type=Digital Liner|url=http://www.thebeachboys.com/#?news=4111}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last=Black |first=Frank |url=http://fridaynightboys300.blogspot.co.uk/2014/12/the-beach-boys-1964-keep-eye-on-summer.html |title=FRIDAY NIGHT BOYS: The Beach Boys 1964: Keep an Eye on Summer – new copyright extension release |website=Fridaynightboys300.blogspot.co.uk |date=December 3, 2014 |access-date=September 27, 2016}}</ref>

'''The Beach Boys'''
* [[Al Jardine]] – harmony and backing vocals, bass guitars, handclaps
* [[Mike Love]] – verse lead, harmony, and backing vocals, handclaps
* [[Brian Wilson]] – chorus lead, harmony, and backing vocals, piano, [[harpsichord]], [[Hammond organ]], handclaps
* [[Carl Wilson]] – harmony and backing vocals, electric lead and rhythm guitars, handclaps
* [[Dennis Wilson]] – harmony and backing vocals, drums, handclaps

'''Session musicians''' (also known as "[[the Wrecking Crew (music)|the Wrecking Crew]]")
{{div col begin}}
* [[Hal Blaine]] – [[timbales]] with puili sticks
* [[Steve Douglas (saxophonist)|Steve Douglas]] – tenor saxophone
* [[Jay Migliori]] – baritone saxophone
* [[Ray Pohlman]] – [[Extended-range bass|6-string electric bass guitar]]s
{{div col end}}
sections.text:
Per John Brode, Will Crerar, Joshilyn Hoisington, and Craig Slowinski.

The Beach Boys
* Al Jardine – harmony and backing vocals, bass guitars, handclaps
* Mike Love – verse lead, harmony, and backing vocals, handclaps
* Brian Wilson – chorus lead, harmony, and backing vocals, piano, harpsichord, Hammond organ, handclaps
* Carl Wilson – harmony and backing vocals, electric lead and rhythm guitars, handclaps
* Dennis Wilson – harmony and backing vocals, drums, handclaps

Session musicians (also known as "the Wrecking Crew")
{{div col begin}}
* Hal Blaine – timbales with puili sticks
* Steve Douglas – tenor saxophone
* Jay Migliori – baritone saxophone
* Ray Pohlman – 6-string electric bass guitars
{{div col end}}
